section_plans.DKC-11: Pan flute and Djafe converse above cave percussion and actual low-string roots. Quiet metal stays behind; the70.5s chord arrival is reduced2.4dB, with residual swell still an owner-review choice. Source echoes remain separate low-level prints.
section_plans.DKC-15: Two declared string-bass studio voices: foreground hook and low foundation. Muted/sustained states follow source roles; short guitars yield. Correct the factory notation octave before judging melodic placement.
section_plans.DKC-19: Wood motor and low root establish pulse. Hand drums propel it; piano marks arrivals and separate raw flutes call. The low-wind bend uses a tested two-semitone wheel range.
section_plans.DKC-13: Low strings, a wooden upper repeated figure, wide piano responses and distinct winds trade roles. Source9 changes function across registers; follow the gesture rather than numeric program labels. A genuinely playable bass-led alternative remains available.
